svg.aria-label: Small systems: Small systems, gated on GameState. One system does one thing. Events: Systems talk through events (SoundEvent, DeathEvent). Features stay independent. Render order: The renderer draws shapes with bloom. The CRT shader runs last, at a quality tier per platform. One codebase: The same code builds native and WASM. Only the quality tier changes
